meta.name: pull-requests
meta.description: Create and review pull requests following project standards including title format, description template, and review checklist. Use when creating PRs, writing PR descriptions, or reviewing pull requests.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按项目规范创建和审查拉取请求
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常需要创建或审查拉取请求并遵循团队标准。
copy.tagline_en: Create and review pull requests following project standards
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often create or review pull requests and need to follow team standards.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按照项目标准帮你创建和审查 pull request，包括指定标题格式、使用描述模板，并提供审查清单。
howto.when: 当你要求创建 pull request、写 PR 描述或审查 PR 时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个 PR，标题是 "RI-123 添加用户资料编辑"
say.note: Claude 会按标题格式和描述模板生成 PR。

say.text: 审查这个 PR，检查逻辑错误和测试覆盖
say.note: Claude 会依据审查清单逐项检查。

howto.what_en: Claude will help create and review pull requests following project standards, including title format, description template, and review checklist.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create a PR, write a PR description, or review a PR.

say_en.text: Create a PR with title "RI-123 Add user profile editing"
say_en.note: Claude will follow the title format and description template.

say_en.text: Review this PR for logic errors and test coverage
say_en.note: Claude will use the review checklist.
